name: Carbazocine
summary: Carbazocine is an opioid analgesic of the benzomorphan family which was never marketed.

uses.text: Carbazocine is an opioid analgesic of the benzomorphan family which was never marketed.

summaryZh: 卡巴佐辛（英語：Carbazocine）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C22H28N2，屬於苯嗎喃衍生物類阿片鎮痛藥，從未上市。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids in general cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。一般來說，鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便秘與依賴，過量時可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。一般来说，鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与依赖，过量时可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止。

fact.en: It belongs to the benzomorphans, a family made by chemists who stripped the morphine molecule down to a simpler frame. The best-known member is pentazocine.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯并嗎啡烷類，這是化學家把嗎啡分子簡化成較單純骨架而得到的家族。其中最有名的成員是噴他佐辛。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯并吗啡烷类，这是化学家把吗啡分子简化成较单纯骨架而得到的家族。其中最有名的成员是喷他佐辛。
